headlines.text: Flash back to 2026, when FTR vs. Davis & Doyle went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.42. Davis & Doyle was challenging for gold for the very first time. This stood as the 90th match in AEW World Tag Team Titles history ? a real piece of championship history. FTR retained the AEW World Tag Team Championship over Don Callis Family's Mark Davis and Jake Doyle, with Jon Moxley's interference proving decisive.
2026 brought us this moment: Andrade El Idolo vs. Swerve Strickland closed out Dynamite, rated 8.17 ? a fantastic contest.

Looking back to 2026, when Mark Briscoe vs. El Clon fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.11 ? a strong outing. For El Clon, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
